Replit return refund policy US.excerpt:
A clear path forward

# Am I eligible for a refund?

You may be able to get a refund for a subscription payment. Subscription payments may be refunded within 30 days of purchase. For a monthly subscription, only the latest payment may qualify. A yearly subscription cannot be refunded after 30 days. Agent and AI usage charges, and domain purchases, cannot be refunded.
